english.title: Take photo / film etc for the purposes of a trade / employment etc within Trafalgar Square without permission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within Trafalgar Square, other than when acting in accordance with permission given in writing by the Mayor or a person authorised by the Mayor to give such permission,

(A)_[took photographs]_
(B)_[filmed]_
(C)_[made a recording of visual images]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE..)]_

for the purposes of or in connection with a business, trade, profession or employment or activity carried out by a person or body of persons, namely **(..SPECIFY BUSINESS ETC..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 5(1)(p) of the Trafalgar Square Byelaws 2012 and section 385(3)(b) of the Greater London Authority Act 1999.

english.notes: (i) As per byelaw 5(1), unless acting in accordance with permission given in writing by the Mayor , or any person authorised by the Mayor under section 380 of the Act to give such permission, no person shall within the Square carry out any acts covered in byelaws 5(1)(a) to 5(1)(w).(ii) As per byelaw 9, where an authorised person has reasonable ground for belief that a person has contravened any one or more of the Byelaws, that person shall give on demand his name and address to that authorised person.
